entry.title: pokecapn's top 30+ kpop of 2024
entry.content:
(the rules)

  1. Yes I know this is 10-11 months late. it's because I'm a time traveler but I'm really bad at it
  2. I listened to a staggering amount of title tracks, album cuts, and everything in between, to bring you 30 kpop songs from 2024 that Kick Ass per my exacting and arbitrary standards
  3. No other year-end lists tainted these judgments. I may be the world's worst time traveler, but I am no cheater
  4. For songs with music videos, if it's full of random sound effects or breaks that aren't there in the real song, I pick a performance video or the audio only, so you can listen to the actual song
  5. In 2024 a lot of songs lived and died by the fatness of their bass. But first, some awards for songs that didn't make the list:

previous years: 2017 | 2018 | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023

awards

The "Take On Me" Award: 015B feat. Yireh - Memory Washer

The Most Likely To Be A Boss Song In Some Rhythm Game Award: Xdinary Heroes - Xymphony

The Most Likely To Be A Boss Song Specifically In Muse Dash Award: yurisa - NYA?

The Don't Let Kids Near The Pryda Snare Award: Curious - Call Me Up

The This Song Technically Came Out In 2023 So I Can't Put It In The List Award: MayLiz - Tonight

Da Ali G Achievement In Speed Garage Award: Chungha - Algorithm (Mar Vista Remix)

The Most Improved By Replacing The Entire Song Award: STAYC - Meow (Remix Version)

The Interrupting Pryda Snare Award: NiziU - Sweet Nonfiction

The Most 808 Cowbell Award: Jennie - Mantra

The Most Saxophone Award: Kim Areum - Past Tense (Saxophone Version by Jay Kim)

the list

30) TAN - Area

Immediately gets in your face and hits the ground running, very very slightly ravey in the verses. Love the brogressive house synths in the first pre-chorus

29) I-LAND2 N/α Contestants - Final Love Song (Applicants Version)

hnGRhH Colonel, I'm trying to write some throwaway dance version of "The Final Countdown" for a reality show. But the bass is dummy thicc and the clap of my headphones keeps alerting the judges...

28) Babymonster - Forever

The Temu version of Blackpink's "As If It's Your Last" is not going to have the same staying power, but A for effort

27) Key - Overthink

I recommend not overthinking this, it's good housey stuff you can get all over

26) Lil Cherry - Crying In Da Club

Channeling Scooter in both sound and shitpostiness. Someone please teach Lil Cherry and Goldbuuda about gabber

25) The Wind - I Don't Thing

Here's the feel-good happy virus of the list. Just a fun song with 80s synth sentiments

24) Wooah - Pom Pom Pom

Bear with me, because this song is so bad it wraps back around. eSports dreck (that's a genre) full of fascinating choices. 5 seconds of synthwave, a psytrance guitar shredding chorus, and borderline eurobeat in the bridge

23) fromis_9 - Supersonic

Check out fromis_9's new single "Supersonic" if you get the chance. Sound of the summer.

22) Weeekly - Lights On

A retread of "Tag Me" that's almost good enough to make you forget that "Ven Para" existed. Almost. I like that bitcrushed crash in the pre-chorus. But now I wish I had one of those mind-erasing songs

21) Chungha - I'm Ready

Zero bullshit floor filler

20) Fifty Fifty - SOS

This follows the "Cupid" formula better than "Cupid" did. A nice breezy dreamy fluffball

19) Kep1er - Tipi-Tap

Of all the garridges, and there were a lot of garridges, I enjoyed this one the most. It drills its way into your brain and then the drums and bass go nuts in the post-chorus

18) aespa - Whiplash

This fashion runway show stuff is a perfect fit for kpop and it needs a name. I'm calling the genre "haute house"

17) fromis_9 - Take A Chance

Great sounds here. It's a shame their contract ended and we won't get another foray into the Jepsenesque, I say, winking at the camera, because I'm not actually writing this in 2024. It's a joke, cause we did get another one this year. Anyway,

16) STAYC - 1 Thing

If you keep doing that shit with the flash, you're gonna run it out of batteries, and then good luck taking any pictures!!! This will rot your brain, you've been warned.

15) Le Sserafim - Crazy

Haute house returns, but dumber and more repetitive. But that actually makes it better. I think putting "Crazy" above "Whiplash" is the hottest take in the list

14) Kep1er - Shooting Star

There were a couple of songs in this style this year. Twice's "I Got You" could have fit in this slot. But cranking up the overwrought sentimentality beyond 11 to 12 is kinda cool

13) Kwon Eunbi - Sabotage

You're going to wonder why such a tremendous europop number is so low. By that time, the second verse should be starting, aaand it just shits up the whole thing. You might say... it Sabotages itself

12) Taemin - Horizon

The filthmaster is back with a synthwave slammer

11) Purple Kiss - On My Bike

Guess I'm more nostalgic for the Max Martin-era Britney sound than I thought I was. Love how much this one chugs. "Car for the body but a bike for the soul" is an all-time lyric

10) NMIXX - Run For Roses

graaaaagh! I'm doing moves in the Home Depot light bulb aisle! aAAAgh! Loading top soil on that stupid cart thing! I'm gonna ff-f-fuckin start a project! uhuHHHuuuuUUyhg

9) Chuu - Strawberry Rush

You probably don't need to be told this if you're reading this list, but good and goofy are not mutually exclusive. Insert man screaming at ass here. Once again, Chuu has the best "Blinding Lights" of the year

8) Kim Areum feat. Spacecowboy - Full Moon

Batman slurring his speech WHERE'S THE DISCO??? WHERE IS IT????? Here it is. Actually, open a new tab and listen to Kim Areum's whole discography, it's great

7) Rescene - YoYo

Once again the bass is a standout, but all the elements, pads, drums, vocals, just click into place here. The deeper breathy vocals in the chorus are a great contrast to kpop's all highs all the time

6) NMIXX - Love Is Lonely

I've got nothing clever to say. It's just a beautiful song

5) Illit feat. Ava Max - Baby It's Both

Pure Eiffel 65 / Sabrina Paris era eurodance. Really cleverly uses the vocals of the original version as the synth riff. Slam dunk.

4) aespa - Supernova

The best aespa tracks always sound like Transformers on the toilet. The last 15 seconds where everything comes in at once with added screeching is fantastic. If more songs interpolated Trans Europe Express this list could write itself

3) Red Velvet - Cosmic

It's already good from the start, funky, dancy, but ohhh man the chorus. The chorus rules. The bassline is viscous, enormous, pounding. You've got disco strings and over the top melancholic vocals. This really grew on me

2) Illit - Magnetic

The final boss of the 2024 basslines, making the whole song bouncy and irresistibly catchy. You you you you you you you you will think of this song at the absolute least appropriate times. Such is the plight of the kpop enthusiast

1) Ive - Accendio

Musically evokes the "fire starting" the title translates to. Verse 1's metallic plodding is striking flint ➔ ignites into 140 bpm. Cuts out beat verse/chorus 2 when fire wavers. Nothing in chorus 1 ➔ quiet synth stabs chorus 2 ➔ strings chorus 3! Inferno!

Thank You For Playing

entry.title: pokecapn's top 30+ kpop of 2023
entry.content:
(the rules)

  1. i went through countless title tracks, album cuts, and everything in between, to bring you
  2. 30 kpop songs that Kick Ass per my exacting standards, "awards" for 12 songs that missed or would never make the cut, and a bonus playlist with an additional nearly 250 songs i found good or at least entertaining
  3. no other year-end lists tainted these judgments. it is quite hard to avoid spoilers but i must bear that burden as a consequence of getting lost in the Content Swamp
  4. 2023 had a crazy amount of competent songs with a lot of great sounds. "blinding lights" is now a kpop subgenre. i sidelined a ton of drum & bass and garage because it's now the norm instead of the novelty.
  5. in the spirit of variety, i intentionally replaced songs that rhymed too closely with ones higher on the list. i could probably build a parallel universe of this entire post

previous years: 2017 | 2018 | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022

awards

The Literally Just "Take On Me" Award - Minigame Star: tripleS - New Look

The Literally Just "Take On Me" Award - Coin Star: ZeroBaseOne - In Bloom

The Pryda Snare Award: Dohwa, Elly, Yeoreum, Yeeun, Juri, Jiwoo, Hwiseo - Last Piece

The Saxophone Award: Kim Areum - Summer Love

The Saxophonest Award: Kim Areum - Summer Love (Saxophone Version)

The Moustache Mixtape Award: B.I feat. Kid Milli & Lil Cherry - Wave

The #sponsored Award - Minigame Star: aespa - Hold On Tight

The #sponsored Award - Coin Star: NewJeans - Zero

The Why Did The Lion Get Lost in The Forest Award: Hypnosis Therapy - Jongno

The Comic Sans of Music Award: NiziU - Love & Like

The Most Improved By Putting a Donk On It Award: Jisoo - Flower (KAZERR Remix)

The Most Improved By Replacing The Entire Song Award: NCT 127 - 2 Baddies (Biicla Remix)

The Dumbest Song Award: Hijvc Kid feat. Cherry Boy 17 - No More Bitch

the list

30) ILY:1 - Twinkle Twinkle

Let's kick things off with a nice little bit of dreamy synthscape. This does nothing as memorable as Oh My Girl's entries in the field, but you gotta give credit where it's due for keeping the sound alive

29) Dreamcatcher - Rising

As a thoroughly basic being I crave two things: Pumpkin Spice Lattes and the angsty DnB cheese of Pendulum. Dreamcatcher's attempt at the Pendul-esque scratches the itch but doesn't satisfy the urge. This bass wasn't really strong enough

28) Mimirose - Tipsy

A whiplash ride between stanky electro and cheery anthemic dance. When more songs sample/quote Cybotron, this list will finally be able to write itself

27) BXB - Fly Away

It feels like shit's going down right from the start. A throwback to boy group songs past where everyone was moody and felt like they had something to prove. Nice guitar bit at the end that really needed more room to breathe

26) tripleS LOVElution - Speed Love

solid snake voice LIQUIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIID

25) from20 - Beat It

No bullshit synthwave that makes all the right choices. The synths are juicy, the snare's great, the pace is speedy, the vocals slot right in. The only misstep is inviting the MJ comparison with the title choice; don't mess with the maestro

24) CSR - Shining Bright

Speaking of lattes you know how you can't get a normal one? It's gotta be a Crystallized Syrupy Ristretto or something. That's not what CSR stands for, but this is the audio equivalent, so let's all Chug and Charge and start vibrating at 3PM

23) Lee Chaeyeon - I Don't Wanna Know

"Drift Phonk" seems to have more in common with electro house than its bass-clipping trap namesake, but we can let the TikTokers think they've discovered a new genre. Cool sounds that'll get tired, until they add some hoovers

22) tripleS +(KR)ystal Eyes - Cherry Talk

The first entry that's a real earworm threat. Your defenses will be busy fending off all the random crap in the instrumental, you'll recover just in time for the slap bass in the bridge, and then it's all boom cherry talk ch

21) Xikers - Rockstar

A great job at evoking some kind of bizarre rap-punk aesthetic despite having pretty much none of either. Hitting with the full 172 BPM each chorus and doubling up at the end makes this a relentless energy assault

20) Yena - Wicked Love

That brief period around the year 2000 when pop got good again is eternally symbolized by red latex and NOT by referencing 3 year old movies. So taking the Oops I Did It Again formula and smoothing all the edges off is guaranteed success

19) Kwon Eunbi - The Flash

This definitely feels like the producers tried to make a friendlier Glitch for round 2. The formula's mostly there as well as a lot of the textures, but reeling in the madness makes for mere greatness rather than incredibleness

18) JYP - Changed Man

I think I've said this before, but JYP perfectly understands the inherent shittiness of the sound of the 80s and can channel that vibe without a hint of irony. Everything sucks just a little bit more than it should and it rules

17) fromis_9 - Attitude

Here's some smooth housey stuff that feels like it's constantly building up pressure in your brain. You hit the final chorus and that's enough to push the valve out of the way and steam starts pouring out. that's just fromis_9 cooking

16) Young Posse - Macaroni Cheese

By all logic this song is straight garbage, but having a bunch of kids rap about macaroni and cheese over an insanely competent instrumental is actually brilliant and I can't stop listening to it. Kpop is coming for your groceries

15) NMIXX - Party O'Clock

It turns out NMIXX's only problem was being given dumpster-tier songs. The mixing's a little wack but it doesn't get in the way of extremely catchy pop-glossy garage

14) Cignature - Parade

Cignature's producers are always dancing on a knife's edge when it comes to making something awesome versus barely listenable swill. You could argue they failed here, and you're not wrong, but I love how bonkers the second half of the chorus is

13) Heejin - Algorithm

Most tripleS/ARTMS title tracks in 2023 had a decent instrumental and a bunch of "la la la" instead of real catchy melodies. Algorithm has that, but beat the system by making everything else way better, especially the vocal syncopation in the chorus

12) NewJeans - ETA

I don't think other producers really "get" the effectiveness of this effortless effort, Rhodesy East-Coast Clubby sound when they try to copy NewJeans. It turns out you still can innovate with the Think break, and yes, ETA was the better single than Super Shy

11) DreamNote - Lemonade

Musically more like a Cold Brew Shandy, where you wonder if this recipe blog is some kind of psyop as you pour the coffee and lemonade into a glass. You take a sip and you're pretty sure nothing came together right. But you're making a second glass

10) Weeekly - Sweet Dream

An already oddly sinister sound that takes Love Cherry Motion-style trips to Hell. If this followed through on the absolutely incredible threat it made of going completely off the rails right before the third chorus, it would be a masterpiece

9) NMIXX - Roller Coaster

More like... Roland Coaster lmao!!! An absolute feast of Synthesizer, and I think the relative "simplicity" lets NMIXX show off their vocals in a way that doesn't distract from the main job as the top line melody

8) LE SSERAFIM - Eve, Psyche & The Bluebeard's wife

As soon as club sound entered kpop, tons of songs tried to squeeze it in whatever they were originally making. But here it all makes sense, the manic energy fits the theme, and there's tons of instantly catchy hooks

7) Chuu - Aliens

Of all the Blinding Lightses, of which there were dozens, if not more, Chuu's was the best. You need someone with strong enough vocals to command attention away from the energy. And I can just drink the more melancholy vibe compared to its contemporaries

6) STAYC - Bubble

Mercilessly cheery and uplifting. You will get addicted to the synths. You will get addicted to the bubble bubble bubble. The only reason this isn't higher is because we all know 808s kick

5) aespa - Spicy

Goes way harder than it has any right to. Monster bass and the main synth is what Megatron's doing to the toilet after drinking too many Crystal Sugar Ristrettos. Little bit of acid lurking around. Countless goodies in here

4) Viviz - Untie

A straight up house banger that stays an unsettlingly long time in vocal fry range. What I liked the most was all the Big Room House synth tropes running at the wrong speed in the pre-chorus and bridge. Just kidding what I liked the most was Eunha

3) Apoki - Space

This is the italo synthwave perfection you ordered. All the instrumentation is spot on and everything has room to breathe. The singer behind Apoki delivers a whirlwind of emotion and you can just sit back and melt into the track

2) Ive - Classic

Making this list took a while because I HAD to hear Classic all the way through each time. The bass is absolutely cracked, the vocal mix is haunting, there's an unreal mood throughout. Most importantly, I racked up my biggest Balatro scores with this on loop

1) Ive - I Am

The ultimate feel-good anthem. There's constant propulsion from the swung triplet time. The instrumental cuts back to force the vocals to be as confident as the lyrics imply. It feels bigger than the sum of its parts. YOU feel bigger than the sum of your parts

Thank You For Playing

BONUS PLAYLIST

here is a playlist with everything on the list, along with 250 other songs, for over 15 hours of kpop beats to relax/study to

entry.title: empty kpop sets make for insane liminal spaces
entry.content:
so every morning I head over to r/liminalspace and pick my new Zoom background for the day. this serves as a nice mini-ritual to start work and makes meetings ever so slightly more fun. I've been doing this, although not always with that subreddit, for something like 5 and a half years at this point. that is a lot of "liminal spaces" i've exposed myself to.

there is much argument over what is and isn't a liminal space, but since I just find it really funny that people experience spiritual levels of emotion to a picture of an empty hotel lobby with the elevator open, I'm don't really sweat the details. I think as long as you get the sense that you're alone, and either moving from point A to point B or taking a pit stop somewhere uselessly detached from society, that's a liminal space.

all of which leads me to a brilliant brainstorm I had in the middle of the night in 2021, when I was re-watching Pristin V's Get It (as you do) and there was this second-long shot of an empty room with a nonsense hexagonal couch, fluorescent lighting, and a bunch of mirrors going nowhere. that's when I realized that in the quest for hyper-stimulating visuals, kpop music videos end up churning out insane liminal spaces as set pieces. normally you don't pick up on it because someone is almost always there on the set, interrupting the liminality, but I cracked the code.

so I made a tweet with that shot, another shot from the same MV, and a couple more I had remembered or thought I remembered from other MVs. I had a followup ready to go in the afternoon to get more eyeballs on it because I thought it was really good. and then, I kept going. it was now just the secondary game I play of "find the liminal spaces" whenever I watch music videos or their behinds. appending to the thread every two weeks or so, I've now hit about 300 kpop liminal spaces.

with Twitter dead, I've decided to keep the thread going on Bluesky, but I also collected the whole thing in this imgur gallery that hopefully I'll remember to keep updated. these images are pokecapn-approved for your own Zoom backgrounds, or for any time you need to zone out and drift between realities:

kpop liminal spaces

entry.title: pokecapn's top 30+ kpop of 2022
entry.content:
(the rules)

  1. i listened to over 1500 songs, to bring you
  2. 30 that Kick Ass per my exacting standards for this list, "awards" for 10 more songs that weren't making the cut, and another 125 i found good or at least entertaining in a bonus playlist
  3. no year end lists tainted these judgments. all opinions are my own. probably
  4. original air date: November 29, 2023

previous years: 2017 | 2018 | 2019 | 2020 | 2021

awards

The Best Cover(?) Award: Funtwo, Jane, AZ - aespa - Next Level (Guitar Cover)

The Literally Just "Take On Me" Award: Pentagon - Sparkling Night

The Pryda Snare Award - Coin Star: Psy - Everyday

The Pryda Snare Award - Minigame Star: Seulgi - Los Angeles

The Pryda Snare Award - Happening Star: Lapillus - Queendom

The "We Have A Taemin Track At Home" Award: KOM - Adrenaline

The "No Really, The Song Is Good Too, Honest!" Award: (tie) Kara - When I Move, Apink Bomi & Hayoung - Red Carpet

The This Sucks But I Keep Thinking About It Award: Ryeohwa feat. Mistakim - Cowboy

The Most Likely To Have Been Rejected From A Mission: Impossible Soundtrack Award: Itzy - Voltage

the list

30) NewJeans - Hype Boy

no one singing this song has installed Windows XP before, but that didn't stop them from cranking all the numbers up and trying anyway

29) Chungha - Sparkling

a smooth and refreshing twist on the 160ish bpm synthpop formula that we've seen for the past couple of years. literally refreshing! cans open! in the song!

28) Pixy - Villain

very cool and nasty. am i the only one blacking out and seeing rapid-fire pictures of cats during the choruses? just me? i should get that looked at.

27) Red Velvet - Snap Snap

i think it's aiming for a naughty 2.0, a great house thumper that SM has regularly been able to give its artists

26) Billlie - GingaMingaYo (the strange world)

by all means i should just bounce right off the singsongy nursery rhyme chorus, but the fatness of the track and chewiness of the synths keeps me coming back

25) Oh My Girl - Replay

vicious destruction coming out of nowhere. 2 and a half very short minutes of dank filth

24) Wonho - Eye On You

a no bullshit track that cruises along, with great pauses to build up and release tension, and delightful synths that crank up during the chorus. energizer

23) STAYC - Poppy

i could have held this until the 2023 list since it did get a korean version but i though-POPPY POPPY POPOPPY POPPY POPPY LOVE LOVE POPPY POPPY POPOPPY POPPY POPPY LOVE LOVE POPPY POPPY POPOPPY POPPY POPPY LOVE LOVE POPPY POPPY POPOPPY PO

22) Drippin - The One

this year's production team that shows up multiple times in the list is the tag team of TAK & Corbin at NEWTYPE, starting with this fantastic drum & bass pop-rock hybrid. a great way to start your day

21) Purple Kiss - Pretty Psycho

the philosophy for purple kiss house tracks seems to be to load up a solid foundation with random shit and it works great. beethoven, classic movie samples, and speed garage wobble, together at last

20) Nature - Limbo

if more songs could detour into 10 seconds of psytrance for no reason that'd be swell, thanks

19) woo!ah! - Rollercoaster

it's finally time to slow down and enjoy a synthwave dreamscape. CRJ energy will be channeled several times on this trip up the list

18) fromis_9 - Rewind

while we mourn the death of any wild ass concepts ever gracing fromis_9 again, we can still appreciate solid heavily replayable b sides like this

17) Limelight - Starlight

slots right into the izone gap you didn't know you had. that one meme but the guy's going "it my fiesta fr!!!!"

16) Key - Bound

yo man what you got there, sega genesis???? the fm synth bass is off the charts

15) Yena - Pretty Boys

picture-perfect 80's throwback. way too good to be trapped on an EP with no promotion

14) Nayeon - Pop!

fast-paced bass, brass, and heys. hold on a second. now just what exactly are we popping here.

13) ATEEZ - Halazia

this one's a real ride between insanely high and deep vocals, going off the rails into drum and bass and hardstyle at the end. waiting for the day that "off the rails" becomes "the rails". that'll be something

12) Le Sserafim - Blue Flame

it's simple, it's catchy, and the star of the show is the megabass 2000 watt rms in the prechorus

11) Viviz - Bop Bop!

ezaels ocsid nimmals

10) Limelight - Eye To Eye

strap in for another dreamscape. the vocals have more room to work than the other limelight track and you can just lie down and let the waves roll in

9) Ive - Love Dive

doomsday plodding processed out the goat ass. this is a compliment. i'm convinced they're going for an another brick in the wall vibe

8) Kep1er - MVSK

a relentless assault where the only constant is change. many angry basses, unintelligible synth brass, anti-drops becoming real drops, and a trip into triplet time just for fun

7) Kwon Eunbi - Croquis

pounding productivity-enhancing house. i can and have put this on repeat for an hour. 2:17 is a great advancement in "vocals as instrument"

6) Rocket Punch - Louder

this song fucks. no further explanation needed, just listen to it

5) Taeyeon - INVU

effortless emotional dreamworld. mirror-polished. you get the feeling no one was allowed to mess this one up

4) CSR - Pop? Pop!

pure sugar fresh air with a truckload of cool rhythms and sounds. the part before the third chorus is like a boast from the production team: "we could have made this absolute dogshit, but we are masters of the craft in full control"

3) WJSN Chocome - Super Yuppers!

the song: the 80s are here, again. me:

2) Cherry Bullet - Love In Space

what's 156 bpm, is dominated by offbeat bass stabs, and features 16th note melodies? that's right, they've finally discovered the secret formula to poppify eurobeat

1) Kwon Eunbi - Glitch

a journey into sound. discover silken vocals weaving through garage with massive build ups into chunky four on the floor, replete with the titular glitching. then get blasted by the finish. lost in chimes, you conclude: "damn"

Thank You For Playing

BONUS PLAYLIST

here is a playlist with a total of 165 songs from 2022. why 165? because i got tired of cutting songs from the list

entry.title: pokecapn's top 30+ kpop of 2021
entry.content:
(the rules)

  1. all tracks are fair game, i listened to.. a lot
  2. i like my kpop like my GoldenEye 64—Slappers Only
  3. "unbiased". i somehow avoided seeing any year end lists
  4. there's a bonus at the end!
  5. actually it's Remote Mines

previous years: 2017 | 2018 | 2019 | 2020

2023 edit: I have tried to preserve as much of the original tweet thread as possible. Dead links have been fixed, formatting tweaked to work with cohost the blogosphere, but otherwise the order and descriptions are straight from July 23 2022, whatever that entails.

awards

The This Should Have Been In 2020's List And Probably Like Number One Or Two Award: IZ*ONE - Daydream

The Pryda Snare Award: Skyle - Fly Up High

The Literally Just "Take On Me" Award: Rocket Punch - Ring Ring

Best Intro Track Award: Chungha - Side C (Unknown)

Most Improved By Replacing The Entire Song Award: Shinee - Don't Call Me (Fox Stevenson Remix)

The "I don't get it, is that good" Award: (tie) Billlie - Ring x Ring, Purple Kiss - Ponzona

the list

30) PinkFantasy - Poison

Dreamcatcher's Piri gets more of a J-feel to it and picks up a guitar solo and some cool eurotrance synths in the chorus

29) Bébe Yana - Strawberry Kisses

it's pronounced "garridge"

28) Everglow - Pirate

we got us a map, to lead us to a big room track, that's choreoed for tiktok, and buried deep away. we'll dig up the track, we know it's full of precious brass stabs. tik open the toks, and then we'll say "now let me introduce myself

27) Red Velvet - Pose

i don't even remember what the title track on this album was, because it so obviously should have been Pose. the synths in the verses unnerve you just enough to release all that tension during the chorus

26) Do Han Se - Take Over

sure, it's filthy, but absolutely nothing will prepare you for what happens at 2:44 in the video no matter how many times you watch it

25) Hot Issue - Gratata

this song tries so hard it triggers quality underflow and wraps around to kicking ass. it's got like 40 or 50 heys. sometimes i wonder if all famous snipers know how to bang-ah bang-ah bang-ah. please let me have this

24) Everglow - Nighty Night

one day, hoovers will grace kpop more frequently than once every 2 or 3 years, and i will finally be able to have this list write itself

23) aespa - Next Level

SM has a history of buying existing tracks and making them more memorable than the originals. i kinda hope aespa's concept never changes and the heartfelt ballad sections of their concerts are total fucking nonsense about nft snakes

22) SHINee - Atlantis

it's by-the-numbers kpop, but the chorus synth goes hard as shit

21) Dreamcatcher - Whistle

gonna tell my kids this was blackpink's lovesick girls

20) N.O.M - Mega Punch

there is nothing wrong with helping a buddy out

19) Lightsum - You, jam

smashing like 3 decades together and hoping it all works out. when more songs "sample" cybotron, i will finally be able to have this list write itself. there is some monster sub-bass that kicks in from 2:25-2:35

18) Brave Girls feat. E-Chan - Pool Party

one cool thing about 2021's kpop output is that i could have kept this whole list firmly planted in the 80s and it wouldn't even have been wrong

17) Ha:tfelt feat. Keem Hyoeun - Summertime

heavy ethereal plodding

16) AKMU with IU - Nakka

heavier ethereal plodding. death disco

15) Tomorrow X Together - No Rules

a great feature of the microblog is that i can say this song's the freaky lovechild of uptown funk and boom boom dollar and my followers will reply with "what's uptown funk?" not much man what's uptown funk with you

14) Yukika - Secret

that little tinkly synth lets you know exactly what you're getting into. it turns out the composer for this track, dr. jo, also wrote my 2017 no.1, gugudan's a girl like me. i'm sure this won't come up later

13) Mondo Grosso feat. BoA - Everything Needs Love (Re-New JP)
